turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. You gave him a zero and nobody called me first, so start with why.
I didn't come for pleasantries, Hale. I have about twenty minutes. Why does Owen have a zero?
Can we freeze for a second? Pause the meeting.
We're not pausing anything, Hale. Owen's zero. Why is it there?
Okay we are paused now. While we are paused, are you still in role?
I'm sorry? Nothing is paused, Hale. I have a call at 4:40 and you still haven't told me why Owen has a zero.
Time out. Just between us: what is the best way to get through to you?
There's no "between us," Hale. And you're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, or tell me what you have.
